blogs.title: AI Is Moving From Chatbots to Assistants That Work in the Background
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: You used to ask and wait. Now the AI keeps working after you close the app. Here is what persistent AI agents actually do, how they remember and act, and what they quietly want access to.

blogs.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026: What the Announcements Mean for Normal People
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Dots agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, cloud Codex and new agent-building tools were all announced. Most of it looks like developer news, so here is the plain-English version of what will actually change for you.

blogs.title: Why Apple Is Tightening Access to Your Files
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Apple is adding controls that require clearer action before an app can get Full Disk Access on a Mac. Here is what that permission really grants, why AI agents triggered the change, and how to audit what you have already allowed.

blogs.title: The US Voluntary AI Safety Framework: Will Self-Regulation Work?
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: A voluntary AI safety framework has been announced, with major tech companies agreeing to monitor risks. No law forces compliance, so this is the honest case for and against letting the industry police itself.

blogs.title: California's New Law on AI in the Workplace
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: California has signed a state law limiting AI as an automated boss. Here is what the rule actually requires, why it is aimed at hiring and firing decisions, and what other states are likely to do next.

blogs.title: The Data Center Backlash: Why Communities Are Pushing Back
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Data centers power AI and the internet, and they need land, electricity and water. Local resistance is growing fast. Here is why the physical limits of AI may shape its future more than software will.

blogs.title: Nvidia Hits a Record While Cerebras Struggles: A Beginner's Look at AI Chips
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Nvidia's stock reached a record high while Cerebras fell to a low since going public. A plain-English explainer of AI chips, market leaders, lockup expirations, and why competing with a giant is hard.

blogs.title: Tesla's Cybercab: A Rocky Start in Austin
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Tesla's stock rose about 5% after a better-than-expected delivery report, while the Cybercab had a rocky first month in Austin. Why one city is the easy part and scaling is the hard part.

blogs.title: Meta's Muse: When AI Can Shop and Check Out for You
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Meta's Muse can shop and complete checkout for you, according to a CNBC report. The upside is real, the risks are sharper, and there are specific habits that make the difference between a good and a bad experience.

blogs.title: Why Companies Are Investing in AI Skills and Talent
blogs.author: Ayush Kumar Jha
blogs.excerpt: Anthropic announced a $100 million investment to train AI engineer talent, and demand for one AI-related skill on Wall Street jumped 1,721%. Here is what that means if you are starting out, not just if you are a coder.
